name: Conceptual Design & Architecture Principles
description: Translating user research into conceptual structures: User Stories, Backlog, Scaffolding, Simplicity principles, Mental Model System Architecture, Design System Tokens, and Service Blueprinting.

subskills.name: User Stories & Acceptance Criteria
subskills.description: Writing user stories (As a... I want... So that...) with Gherkin acceptance criteria.

subskills.name: Simplicity & Cognitive Load Minimization
subskills.description: Designing short, focused, minimal-step interactions (Hick's Law).

subskills.name: Visibility of System Status & Progress
subskills.description: Providing real-time visual progress feedback, steppers, and breadcrumbs.

subskills.name: Product Backlog Prioritization (MoSCoW / RICE)
subskills.description: Prioritizing UX features using MoSCoW, RICE, or Kano models.

subskills.name: Prominent Success Feedback & Celebrations
subskills.description: Making task completion immediately clear with prominent confirmations and positive reinforcement.

subskills.name: Scaffolding & Progressive Skill Building
subskills.description: Providing temporary support structures that fall away as the user gains competence.

subskills.name: Mental Model System Architecture
subskills.description: Aligning product conceptual models with user mental models to eliminate conceptual dissonance.

subskills.name: Design System Tokens & Multi-Brand Governance
subskills.description: Architecting Design Tokens (color, typography, spacing, elevation) in Figma and code, multi-brand theming, and token governance.

subskills.name: Service Blueprinting & Cross-Functional Touchpoints
subskills.description: Orchestrating frontstage customer actions with backstage employee processes and supporting technical systems.
